written.myAnswer: Observations help identify a problem and suggest a hypothesis. Experiments test deductions drawn from the hypothesis and provide results that help evaluate it.

A hypothesis is tested through experiments. An explanation repeatedly supported by experimental evidence is a theory. A theory repeatedly confirmed through testing may be stated as a law or principle, describing a consistent fact or relationship in nature.
The basic steps are to recognize a problem, make observations, propose a hypothesis, draw deductions, perform experiments, and summarize and report the results.

Laveran observed Plasmodium in the blood of a malaria patient and suggested it caused malaria. A. F. A. King proposed that mosquitoes transmit malaria. Ross demonstrated transmission experimentally using birds, showing that Plasmodium develops in mosquitoes and that infected mosquitoes can transmit it. In 1898, Italian researchers confirmed transmission to humans by allowing an infected Anopheles mosquito to bite a healthy man, who later developed malaria.

Ross allowed a female Anopheles mosquito to feed on a malaria patient, then examined it and found Plasmodium developing in its stomach. For the transmission experiments, he used sparrows rather than risking infection in humans. He fed female Culex mosquitoes on infected sparrows and observed Plasmodium developing in the mosquitoes’ stomach walls and moving to their salivary glands. When these infected mosquitoes bit healthy sparrows, the sparrows developed malaria and Plasmodium was found in their blood. This demonstrated mosquito transmission.

The scientist should observe the plant’s growth in shady and sunny places and propose the hypothesis that it grows faster in shade. The deduction is that, if the hypothesis is correct, comparable plants grown in shade will grow more than those grown in direct sunlight over the same period. Grow plants of the same species under both conditions, keep other factors alike, measure their growth regularly, and compare the results. Then summarize and report the results to evaluate the hypothesis.
